message: Hi, I receive Universal Credit and my housing element covers up to £800 a month. Do you have any properties that accept housing benefit? I've been told by other agencies that they don't take DSS tenants.

result.response:
Great news! Hartwell & Lane **does accept DSS tenants** — we don't have blanket "No DSS" policies. I've found **5 properties** that accept housing benefit within or very close to your £800 budget:

**Within Budget:**
- **PROP-002: 1 bed flat, Coventry** — £750/month (available 15 Mar 2026)
  City centre, furnished, bike storage
- **PROP-006: Studio, Stratford-upon-Avon** — £625/month (available 20 Mar 2026)
  Furnished, bills included, city centre

**Close to Budget (may need top-up):**
- **PROP-007: 2 bed maisonette, Rugby** — £825/month (available 1 Apr 2026)
  Private entrance, garden, parking *(currently under offer)*
- **PROP-001: 2 bed flat, Bristol** — £1,150/month
  Pet-friendly, parking, balcony *(above budget)*

**To apply, you'll need:**
- Photo ID
- Benefits entitlement letter (dated within 3 months)
- 3 months' bank statements
- Previous landlord reference (if you have one)

Landlords may also ask for a guarantor. Top-up payments may be required if your benefit doesn't cover the full rent.

Would you like me to get full details on any of these properties or help you book a viewing?
